Folks — quick legal guideline to close this out: 

- Additional insured: we require an endorsement equivalent to ISO CG 20 10 11 85 (or the carrier's comparable form) for General Liability to afford Redwood the same defense/indemnity protections related to your operations. The endorsement should specifically name "Redwood Inference, Inc." as an Additional Insured.

- Primary/noncontributory: endorsement language should be primary and non‑contributory with respect to any insurance maintained by Redwood for claims arising out of OrbitalAI's operations. This is non‑negotiable for our larger customers.

- Waiver of subrogation: we require Waiver of Subrogation in favor of Redwood where permitted by law — please confirm carrier approval.

- Professional Liability (if applicable): if the work includes professional services or SaaS-related E&O exposures, confirm whether your Professional Liability/E&O policy will include retroactive date coverage and whether a 2–3 year discovery tail is available for terminated coverage (we do not always require tails but need to know timing).

- Certificate data: COI should list policy numbers, limits, effective/expiry dates, carrier name and NAIC, and the endorsement reference (endorsement number or attach the endorsement PDF). A bare COI without the endorsement PDF is not sufficient in many cases.

If your broker can send the actual endorsement PDF (not just a COI note), that will speed review. Please send broker-to-legal contact details if you want us to coordinate directly with the broker.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Associate General Counsel | Redwood Inference
